newsitem.title: USA: DLJ real estate unit forms Colo. partnership.
newsitem.headline: DLJ real estate unit forms Colo. partnership.

text.p: Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette said Wednesday its real estate merchant banking affiliate, DLJ Real Estate Capital Partners LP, has formed a partnership with LaSalle Advisors, a subsidiary of LaSalle Partners, to acquire the Colorado National Bank Buildings from Colorado National Bank.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

DLJ said the property's anchor tenant, Colorado National Bank, will remain in the bank building and consolidate its position in the office tower, freeing up several contiguous floors in the upper portion of the tower for new tenants.

DLJ Real Estate Capital Partners and LaSalle Advisors will invest in an extensive renovation of the tower's interior and exterior, including improvements in the lobby and common areas as well as resurfacing columns on the building's exterior.

"This investment represents a unique value enhancement opportunity for us in the rapidly recovering Denver market," said Andrew P. Rifkin, a New York-based senior acquisition officer for DLJ Real Estate Capital Partners.
